steps.speaker: Roaring Dragon
steps.content: I'll... destroy... Huh?!
You swing your fist, but even though you don't expend much strength, this behemoth gets knocked into the air. It hits a pitch-black gable and falls to the ground.
This paper-like "dragon" defies all your fears. You finally remember where you've seen this striking style—In a game from EMP's second-hand retro game console.
It's not surprising for a mischievous fun-seeker like Mess to have such a dream. But unlike Roulecca, she doesn't appear in her own dream.
No response. Instead, the dragon climbs up again, blocking your way. You can't find a way to beat it completely.

steps.speaker: Roaring Dragon
steps.content: Grrr... Grr... Destroy—arghhh!!
At that moment, an angelic light shines through the darkness. A tall figure strides forward, and a righteous voice fills the cartoonish cavern...
Stop, <color=#fb9259>Draco</color>—Don't hurt the villagers of Ladatom! Your true enemy is the Hero!
So it really is Draco... Villager? Is the voice talking about you? Is this jagged <color=#fb9259>Hero</color> going to save you from the claws of the paper-like Dreadlord?

steps.speaker: Frightened Dragon
steps.content: O Hero... Are you holding... the <color=#fb9259>Sacred Sword</color>?!
The Hero draws the sword from its sheath. The dazzling light instantly blinds your eyes.

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: The evil Dreadlord has awakened. He is spreading darkness and corrupting hearts. But justice will triumph, because the Sacred Sword that will defeat Draco is here...

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: This is the final battle! O Sacred Sword, stand by me to defeat the Dreadlord and save the world!

steps.speaker: Frightened Dragon
steps.content: Nooo...!!!
The weak but unbeatable dragon is finally defeated this time! Its body begins to break up as cartoonish music plays in the background. The cracks spread into the world, reaching you.
The only thing that is not torn apart by the light is the Sacred Sword and the Hero in the center of the light. Is this world going to be destroyed?!
Draco...　has been defeated!
<size=100>Level cleared!</size>
Replay game?
Replay game?
Replay game?
...Why are you so boring?
Here's another chance for you. Hurry up!
The game is about to restart!
The evil Dreadlord has awakened. He is spreading darkness and corrupting hearts. But justice will triumph, because the Sacred Sword that will defeat Draco is here...
<size=60>—Tap anywhere to start the game—</size>
Before you is an uninhabited village, drawn in the same rough, odd style. You are still in Mess's dream, in the "beautiful world" constructed by her subconscious.

The streets are deserted, and the village only has a few basic wooden signs. Though both Mess and Roulecca are mischievous kids, Mess's dream seems so basic and empty compared to the lively, cheerful seacoast of Roulecca's dream.
At that moment, a red headscarf sweeps into view. A tall figure strides forward, and a righteous voice fills the village streets...

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content:
Go to Ladatom Village, find the Blacksmith, clear the Legend of the Sacred Sword, defeat the Dreadlord Draco...
Go to Ladatom Village, find the Blacksmith, clear the Legend of the Sacred Sword, defeat the Dreadlord Draco...

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Huh? There's a hidden character in the second playthrough? Are you the village mayor? That's not mentioned in the mission manual.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: It's me. O mighty Hero, are you looking for the Blacksmith?

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Yeah! It's the main story mission! I'm going to get the Sacred Sword from the Blacksmith and defeat Draco!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Do you know where the Blacksmith is?

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Yeah! The Blacksmith is a super cute girl who works su-per hard to forge weapons. Loud, sonorous clangs will lead me to her... The mission manual said so.

With that, he steps through the gate of the village. Sure enough, loud, sonorous clangs of <color=#fb9259>iron forging</color> can be heard from the depths of the village, and smoke can be seen rising from a distant chimney.

It seems that the main story mission's refresh requirement is for the Hero to enter the village. The character in front of you with the word <color=#fb9259>Hero</color> above his head is the <color=#fb9259>main character</color> of the game. He will push forward the development of this world.
Then...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: O mighty Hero, the Blacksmith is not in the village.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She is being chased by Draco, and has fled to Lato, La... Lalala Forest. She asked me to deliver this message:

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Are you the famous Hero? I need your help!"

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: Huh? Is this a new mission? But you don't have an exclamation mark over your head... Could it be a hidden storyline? But the main story rewards are more enticing...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Complete this mission and get 1800 Hypercubes.
No more acting. Give me the title of the Hero.

steps.speaker: Hero
steps.content: I accept! O Blacksmith of Lalala Forest, I'm coming to save you...
The Hero rushes away like the wind. You turn around, cross the deserted streets towards the smoke and sound of iron-casting, and enter the only open blacksmith forge.
The clangs of iron forging are rhythmic and powerful. The flickering fire illuminates the various weapons hanging on the wall, as well as the half-meter clay dolls on the ground.

The clay dolls look distorted. It is impossible to tell what kind of creatures they're supposed to be. Only the texture of the pitch-black clay feels familiar. Some kinds of strong emotions seem to be sealed within them.

In their midst, you spot the "super cute" Blacksmith as described by the Hero. Her animation style is normal enough, but unlike the little prankster in the real world, this Mess seems like quite the slacker. She lifts her head and peers at you lazily.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Are you this playthrough's Hero?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...I feel like something's missing. You look so unprofessional. Draco is quite strong. Are you sure you can handle him?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I've defeated Draco 32 times with my bare hands...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Quit bragging. Only the Sacred Sword can defeat Draco. It's common sense. You don't even know that? You're really...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Sigh, never mind. It doesn't matter who's the Hero. My Sacred Sword is what defeats Draco anyways. As long as you can pick up the <color=#fb9259>Sacred Sword</color>, then you are the Hero and my only companion.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Wait here. I'll cast the sword for you now.
She climbs a ladder to retrieve a glass bottle from the top shelf. The contents of the bottle shine radiantly. It's the all-too-familiar <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color> coveted by countless souls.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: The raw materials for making a sword. The raw materials for making a Sacred Sword are even more special.
As she speaks, she picks up a clay doll and immerses it in the Ambrosia. Soon, the clay doll starts making strange noises. Black substance oozes from its surface. You realize that it's...
It's the black goo spewed out by Sleepwalkers!
Yet its appearance is only fleeting. The black goo quickly fades and turns into a beautiful golden fluid. Mess takes the flowing gold and begins hammering away.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Here you go. You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'll go fight the Dreadlord once you tell me the source of Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord.
Her gaze freezes at this point, and your conversation enters into an endless loop. It seems that you can't get any new information without continuing the main story.

You have no choice but to accept the golden Sacred Sword. Though you don't sense any powers from it, you feel pulled in by some kind of force when you spot a row of light-colored triangular arrows on the ground.
You leave Mess's forge and the village, and return to the cavern.
The Dreadlord Draco is here. Having forgotten that you beat him 32 times, he slowly rises and props himself up with his huge wings.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can we try to get along? If the Sacred Sword accidentally slays you, the level will be cleared immediately. I don't want to end this playthrough.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is there any other way to advance the story? I just want Mess to be able to say something else. Can you fool her by playing dead?
Draco opens his huge pixelated bloody mouth and greets you with a warm reply...

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!
Before he has a chance to react, you grab the "Hero" sign from his head and punch him in the noggin. The nameless dude yelps and falls unconscious to the ground.
Everything in this sweet dream is as weak as Draco. You place the "Hero" title over your own head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All right. Let's go find the Blacksmith.
Satisfied, you return to the village, cross the deserted streets towards the smoke and sound of iron-casting, and enter the only open blacksmith forge.
The clangs of iron forging are rhythmic and powerful. The flickering fire illuminates the various weapons hanging on the wall, as well as the ugly, half-meter clay dolls on the ground.

The clay dolls look so hideously distorted that you find it impossible to tell what kind of creatures they're supposed to be. Only the texture of the pitch-black clay feels familiar. Some kinds of strong emotions seem to be sealed within them.
In their midst, you spot the "super cute" Blacksmith as described by the Hero. Her animation style is normal enough. When she sees you, or rather the "Hero" title above your head, she stops working.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hero? You're so slow! Wait here. I'll cast the Sacred Sword for you so you can go defeat Draco right away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do I have to fight the Dreadlord right away? I'm not ready yet.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: That's fine. You don't need to prepare anything. My Sacred Sword is what defeats Draco anyways. All you have to do is swing it at the Dreadlord to defeat him.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: The Sacred Sword has been born. The Dreadlord's death is near. This world is about to be saved.
She goes inside and fetches out a small iron container, the contents of which shine radiantly. Upon closer inspection, it's the all-too-familiar Ambrosia coveted by countless souls.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: The raw materials for making a sword. The raw materials for making a Sacred Sword are even more special.

It's the black goo spewed out by Sleepwalkers!
